export default [
    // Math mode
	{trigger: "mk", replacement: "$$0$", options: "tA"},
    {trigger: "dm", replacement: "$$\n\t$0\n$$", options: "tAw"},
	{trigger: /(?<=\S.*)dm/, replacement: "\n$$\n\t$0\n$$", options: "tAw", priority: 1},

	{trigger: /([^\\])beg/, replacement: "[[0]]\\begin{$0}\n\t$1\n\\end{$0}", options: "MA"},
	{trigger: /([^\\])beg/, replacement: "[[0]]\\begin{$0} $1 \\end{$0}", options: "nA"},

    // Dashes
	// {trigger: "--", replacement: "–", options: "tA"},
	// {trigger: "–-", replacement: "—", options: "tA"},
	// {trigger: "—-", replacement: "---", options: "tA"},

    // Greek letters
	{trigger: "@a", replacement: "\\alpha", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@b", replacement: "\\beta", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@g", replacement: "\\gamma", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@G", replacement: "\\Gamma", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@d", replacement: "\\delta", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@D", replacement: "\\Delta", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@e", replacement: "\\epsilon", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: ":e", replacement: "\\varepsilon", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@z", replacement: "\\zeta", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@t", replacement: "\\theta", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@T", replacement: "\\Theta", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: ":t", replacement: "\\vartheta", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: ":f", replacement: "\\varphi", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@i", replacement: "\\iota", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@k", replacement: "\\kappa", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@l", replacement: "\\lambda", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@L", replacement: "\\Lambda", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@s", replacement: "\\sigma", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@S", replacement: "\\Sigma", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@u", replacement: "\\upsilon", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@U", replacement: "\\Upsilon", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@o", replacement: "\\omega", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@O", replacement: "\\Omega", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@h", replacement: "\\eta", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@m", replacement: "\\mu", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@n", replacement: "\\nu", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@x", replacement: "\\xi", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@X", replacement: "\\Xi", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@p", replacement: "\\pi", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@P", replacement: "\\Pi", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@r", replacement: "\\rho", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@j", replacement: "\\tau", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@f", replacement: "\\phi", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@F", replacement: "\\Phi", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@c", replacement: "\\chi", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@q", replacement: "\\psi", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "@Q", replacement: "\\Psi", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "ome", replacement: "\\omega", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "Ome", replacement: "\\Omega", options: "mA"},

    // Text environment
    {trigger: "text", replacement: "\\text{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "\"", replacement: "\\text{$0}$1", options: "mA"},

    // Basic operations
    {trigger: "sr", replacement: "^{2}", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "cb", replacement: "^{3}", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "rd", replacement: "^{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "_", replacement: "_{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "^", replacement: "^{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "sts", replacement: "_\\text{$0}", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "sq", replacement: "\\sqrt{ $0 }$1", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "crt",  replacement: "\\sqrt[3]{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "nrt",  replacement: "\\sqrt[${0:n}]{$1}$2", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "//", replacement: "\\frac{$0}{$1}$2", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "tf", replacement: "\\tfrac{$0}{$1}$2", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "ee", replacement: "\\mathrm{e}^{ $0 }$1", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "eul", replacement: "\\mathrm{e}", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "iu", replacement: "\\mathrm{i}", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "eip", replacement: "\\mathrm{e}^{$0 \\mathrm{i} $1}$2", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "cis", replacement: "\\cos\\!\\left($0\\right) + \\mathrm{i}\\sin\\!\\left($0\\right)$1", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "invs", replacement: "^{-1}", options: "mA"},

    {trigger: /([^\\])(exp|log|ln)/, replacement: "[[0]]\\[[1]]\\!\\left($0\\right)$1", options: "rmA"},
	{trigger: "lgb", replacement: "\\log_{$0}\\!\\left($1\\right)$2", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "conj", replacement: "^{*}", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "Re", replacement: "\\operatorname{Re}\\!\\left($0\\right)$1", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "Im", replacement: "\\operatorname{Im}\\!\\left($0\\right)$1", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "arg", replacement: "\\arg\\!\\left($0\\right)$1", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "bf", replacement: "\\mathbf{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "rm", replacement: "\\mathrm{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "mbb",   replacement: "\\mathbb{$0}$1",    options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "mcal",  replacement: "\\mathcal{$0}$1",   options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "mfrak", replacement: "\\mathfrak{$0}$1",  options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "msf",   replacement: "\\mathsf{$0}$1",    options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "mtt",   replacement: "\\mathtt{$0}$1",    options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "mit",   replacement: "\\mathit{$0}$1",    options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "mbs",   replacement: "\\boldsymbol{$0}$1", options: "mA"},

    // Linear algebra
    {trigger: /([^\\])det/, replacement: "[[0]]\\det\\!\\left($0\\right)$1", options: "rmA", priority: 1},
    {trigger: "tr", replacement: "\\operatorname{tr}\\!\\left($0\\right)$1", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "span", replacement: "\\operatorname{span}\\!\\left($0\\right)$1", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "vcz", replacement: "\\operatorname{vec}\\!\\left($0\\right)$1", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "dom", replacement: "\\operatorname{dom}\\!\\left($0\\right)$1", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "range", replacement: "\\operatorname{range}\\!\\left($0\\right)$1", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "nul",  replacement: "\\operatorname{null}\\!\\left($0\\right)$1",  options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "nlty", replacement: "\\operatorname{nullity}\\!\\left($0\\right)$1", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "col",  replacement: "\\operatorname{col}\\!\\left($0\\right)$1",  options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "row",  replacement: "\\operatorname{row}\\!\\left($0\\right)$1",  options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "dim",  replacement: "\\dim\\!\\left($0\\right)$1",           options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "cnum", replacement: "\\kappa\\!\\left($0\\right)$1", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "ker",  replacement: "\\ker\\!\\left($0\\right)$1",           options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "gcd", replacement: "\\gcd\\!\\left($0\\right)$1", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "lcm", replacement: "\\operatorname{lcm}\\!\\left($0\\right)$1", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "img",  replacement: "\\operatorname{im}\\!\\left($0\\right)$1",   options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "rank", replacement: "\\operatorname{rank}\\!\\left($0\\right)$1", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "dg",   replacement: "\\operatorname{diag}\\!\\left($0\\right)$1",   options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "rref", replacement: "\\xrightarrow{\\mathrm{RREF}}", options: "mA"},

    // More operations
	{trigger: "([a-zA-Z])hat", replacement: "\\hat{[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
    {trigger: "([a-zA-Z])bar", replacement: "\\bar{[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
	{trigger: "([a-zA-Z])dot", replacement: "\\dot{[[0]]}", options: "rmA", priority: -1},
	{trigger: "([a-zA-Z])ddot", replacement: "\\ddot{[[0]]}", options: "rmA", priority: 1},
	{trigger: "([a-zA-Z])tilde", replacement: "\\tilde{[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
	{trigger: "([a-zA-Z])und", replacement: "\\underline{[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
	{trigger: "([a-zA-Z])vec", replacement: "\\vec{[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
    {trigger: "([a-zA-Z]),\\.", replacement: "\\mathbf{[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
	{trigger: "([a-zA-Z])\\.,", replacement: "\\mathbf{[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
	{trigger: "0.,", replacement: "\\mathbf{0}", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "1.,", replacement: "\\mathbf{1}", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "\\\\(${GREEK}),\\.", replacement: "\\boldsymbol{\\[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
	{trigger: "\\\\(${GREEK})\\.,", replacement: "\\boldsymbol{\\[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},

	{trigger: "hat", replacement: "\\hat{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "bar", replacement: "\\bar{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "dot", replacement: "\\dot{$0}$1", options: "mA", priority: -1},
	{trigger: "ddot", replacement: "\\ddot{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "cdot", replacement: "\\cdot", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "tilde", replacement: "\\tilde{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "Wht",  replacement: "\\widehat{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "wbar", replacement: "\\overline{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "wtld", replacement: "\\widetilde{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "wvec", replacement: "\\overrightarrow{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "und", replacement: "\\underline{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "vec", replacement: "\\vec{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
    {
        trigger: "pmod",
        replacement: "\\pmod{${0:n}}$1",
        options: "mA",
        description: "Parenthesized modulo (\\pmod{n})",
    },
	{trigger: "binom", replacement: "\\binom{${0:n}}{${1:k}}$2", options: "mA"},

    // Auto letter subscript
	//
	// x3 -> x_{3}, \alpha3 -> \alpha_{3},
	{
	  trigger: "(\\\\${GREEK}|[A-Za-z])(\\d)",
	  replacement: "[[0]]_{[[1]]}",
	  options: "rmA",
	  priority: -1,
	},
	// x_{3}4 -> x_{34}, \alpha_{3}4 -> \alpha_{34},
	{
	  trigger: "(\\\\${GREEK}|[A-Za-z])_{(\\d+)}(\\d)",
	  replacement: "[[0]]_{[[1]][[2]]}",
	  options: "rmA",
	  priority: -1,
	},

	// \dot{x}3 -> \dot{x}_{3}, \dot{\alpha}3 -> \dot{\alpha}_{3},
	{
		trigger: "\\\\(${ACCENT})\\{(\\\\${GREEK}|[A-Za-z])\\}(\\d)",
	  replacement: "\\[[0]]{[[1]]}_{[[2]]}",
	  options: "rmA",
	  priority: -1,
	},
	
	// \dot{x}_{3}4 -> \dot{x}_{34},
	{
		trigger: "\\\\(${ACCENT})\\{(\\\\${GREEK}|[A-Za-z])\\}_\\{(\\d+)\\}(\\d)",
	  replacement: "\\[[0]]{[[1]]}_{[[2]][[3]]}",
	  options: "rmA",
	  priority: -1,
	},
	// \dot{\vec{a}}3 -> \dot{\vec{a}}_{3},
	{
	  trigger: "\\\\(${ACCENT})\\{\\\\(${ACCENT})\\{(\\\\${GREEK}|[A-Za-z])\\}\\}(\\d)",
	  replacement: "\\[[0]]{\\[[1]]{[[2]]}}_{[[3]]}",
	  options: "rmA",
	  priority: -1,
	},
	// \dot{\vec{a}}_{3}4 -> \dot{\vec{a}}_{34},
	{
		trigger: "\\\\(${ACCENT})\\{\\\\(${ACCENT})\\{(\\\\${GREEK}|[A-Za-z])\\}\\}_\\{(\\d+)\\}(\\d)",
	  replacement: "\\[[0]]{\\[[1]]{[[2]]}}_{[[3]][[4]]}",
	  options: "rmA",
	  priority: -1,
	},

    // Scientific notation: x10 -> \times 10^{}. The auto subscript above turns
    // "x1" into "x_{1}" first, so this matches that state and outranks it on
    // the next keystroke (default priority beats -1). Type "x_10" for x_{10}.
    {trigger: /x_\{1\}0/, replacement: "\\times 10^{$0}$1", options: "rmA"},

    {trigger: "xnn", replacement: "x_{n}", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "\\xii", replacement: "x_{i}", options: "mA", priority: 1},
	{trigger: "xjj", replacement: "x_{j}", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "xp1", replacement: "x_{n+1}", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "ynn", replacement: "y_{n}", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "yii", replacement: "y_{i}", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "yjj", replacement: "y_{j}", options: "mA"},

    // Symbols
    {trigger: "ooo", replacement: "\\infty", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "sum", replacement: "\\sum", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "prod", replacement: "\\prod", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "\\sum", replacement: "\\sum\\limits_{${0:i}=${1:1}}^{${2:n}}\\,$3", options: "m"},
	{trigger: "\\prod", replacement: "\\prod\\limits_{${0:i}=${1:1}}^{${2:n}}\\,$3", options: "m"},
    {trigger: "lim", replacement: "\\lim", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "+-", replacement: "\\pm", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "-+", replacement: "\\mp", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "...", replacement: "\\dots", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "nabl", replacement: "\\nabla", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "hess", replacement: "\\nabla^2 $0", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "grad", replacement: "\\nabla $0", options: "mA"},
    // The operator nabla is also called del, but using "del" as a trigger conflicts with the greek letter delta.
	// {trigger: "del", replacement: "\\nabla", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "xx", replacement: "\\times", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "**", replacement: "\\cdot", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "para", replacement: "\\parallel", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "perp", replacement: "\\perp", options: "mAw"},
	{trigger: "cperp", replacement: "\\perp\\!\\!\\!\\perp", options: "mA"},

	{trigger: "===", replacement: "\\equiv", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: ":=", replacement: "\\coloneqq", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "cong", replacement: "\\cong", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "!=", replacement: "\\neq", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: ">=", replacement: "\\geq", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "<=", replacement: "\\leq", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: ">>", replacement: "\\gg", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "<<", replacement: "\\ll", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "simm", replacement: "\\sim", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "sim=", replacement: "\\simeq", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "approx", replacement: "\\approx", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "prop", replacement: "\\propto", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "prec", replacement: "\\prec", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "preq", replacement: "\\preceq", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "succ", replacement: "\\succ", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "sucq", replacement: "\\succeq", options: "mA"},


    {trigger: "<->", replacement: "\\leftrightarrow ", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "->", replacement: "\\to", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "<-", replacement: "\\leftarrow", options: "m"},
	{trigger: "!>", replacement: "\\mapsto", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "mapsto", replacement: "\\mapsto", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "smap", replacement: "\\overset{${0:C}}{\\mapsto}$1", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "=>", replacement: "\\implies", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "=<", replacement: "\\impliedby", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "iff", replacement: "\\iff", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "==>", replacement: "\\Longrightarrow", options: "mA", priority: 1},
	{trigger: "<=>", replacement: "\\Longleftrightarrow", options: "mA", priority: 1},

	{trigger: "and", replacement: "\\cap", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "orr", replacement: "\\cup", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "inn", replacement: "\\in", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "nni", replacement: "\\ni", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "notin", replacement: "\\not\\in", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "cmp", replacement: "^{c}", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "\\\\\\", replacement: "\\setminus", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "sub=", replacement: "\\subseteq", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "sup=", replacement: "\\supseteq", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "ssub", replacement: "\\subset", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "ssup", replacement: "\\supset", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "eset", replacement: "\\emptyset", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "set", replacement: "\\left\\{ $0 \\right\\}$1", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "e\\xi sts", replacement: "\\exists", options: "mA", priority: 1},

	{trigger: "LL", replacement: "\\mathcal{L}", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "HH", replacement: "\\mathcal{H}", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "CC", replacement: "\\mathbb{C}", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "RR", replacement: "\\mathbb{R}", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: /(\\mathbb\{R\})n/, replacement: "[[0]]^{${0:n}}$1", options: "rmA", description: "\\mathbb{R}^{n} with n as tabstop"},
	{trigger: "ZZ", replacement: "\\mathbb{Z}", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "NN", replacement: "\\mathbb{N}", options: "mA"},

    // Handle spaces and backslashes

    // Snippet variables can be used as shortcuts when writing snippets.
    // For example, ${GREEK} below is shorthand for "alpha|beta|gamma|Gamma|delta|..."
    // You can edit snippet variables under the Advanced snippet settings section.

	{trigger: "([^\\\\])(${GREEK})", replacement: "[[0]]\\[[1]]", options: "rmA", description: "Add backslash before Greek letters"},
	{trigger: "([^\\\\])(${SYMBOL})", replacement: "[[0]]\\[[1]]", options: "rmA", description: "Add backslash before symbols"},

    // Insert space after Greek letters and symbols
	{trigger: "\\\\(${GREEK}|${SYMBOL}|${MORE_SYMBOLS})([A-Za-z])", replacement: "\\[[0]] [[1]]", options: "rmA"},
	{trigger: "\\\\(${GREEK}|${SYMBOL}) sr", replacement: "\\[[0]]^{2}", options: "rmA"},
	{trigger: "\\\\(${GREEK}|${SYMBOL}) cb", replacement: "\\[[0]]^{3}", options: "rmA"},
	{trigger: "\\\\(${GREEK}|${SYMBOL}) rd", replacement: "\\[[0]]^{$0}$1", options: "rmA"},
	{trigger: "\\\\(${GREEK}) hat", replacement: "\\hat{\\[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
	{trigger: "\\\\(${GREEK}) dot", replacement: "\\dot{\\[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
	{trigger: "\\\\(${GREEK}) bar", replacement: "\\bar{\\[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
	{trigger: "\\\\(${GREEK}) vec", replacement: "\\vec{\\[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
	{trigger: "\\\\(${GREEK}) tilde", replacement: "\\tilde{\\[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
	{trigger: "\\\\(${GREEK}) und", replacement: "\\underline{\\[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},


    // Derivatives and integrals
    {trigger: "par", replacement: "\\frac{ \\partial ${0:y} }{ \\partial ${1:x} } $2", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: /pa([A-Za-z])([A-Za-z])/, replacement: "\\frac{ \\partial [[0]] }{ \\partial [[1]] }$0", options: "rmA"},
    {trigger: "pa2", replacement: "\\frac{ \\partial^2 ${0:f} }{ \\partial ${1:x}^2 } $2", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "pa3", replacement: "\\frac{ \\partial^3 ${0:f} }{ \\partial ${1:x}^3 } $2", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "pan", replacement: "\\frac{ \\partial^{${0:n}} ${1:f} }{ \\partial ${2:x}^{$0} } $3", options: "mAw"},
    {trigger: "pam", replacement: "\\frac{ \\partial^2 ${0:f} }{ \\partial ${1:x} \\partial ${2:y} } $3", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: /ppa([A-Za-z])/, replacement: "\\frac{ \\partial }{ \\partial [[0]] } \\left( $0 \\right) $1", options: "rmA"},
        {trigger: /ppa(\?)/, replacement: "\\frac{ \\partial }{ \\partial $0 } \\left( $1 \\right) $2", options: "rmA"},
    // The 2 / 3 lands on a letter, so the auto subscript above has already made
    // it _{2} / _{3} by the time the rest is typed — match that state.
    {trigger: /ppa_\{2\}([A-Za-z])/, replacement: "\\frac{ \\partial^2 }{ \\partial [[0]]^2 } \\left( $0 \\right) $1", options: "rmA"},
    {trigger: /ppa_\{3\}([A-Za-z])/, replacement: "\\frac{ \\partial^3 }{ \\partial [[0]]^3 } \\left( $0 \\right) $1", options: "rmA"},
    {trigger: "ddt", replacement: "\\frac{\\mathrm{d}}{\\mathrm{d}t} $0", options: "mA", priority: 1},
    {trigger: /dd([A-Za-z])/, replacement: "\\frac{\\mathrm{d}}{\\mathrm{d}[[0]]} $0", options: "rmA", priority: -1},
    {trigger: /dd_\{2\}([A-Za-z])/, replacement: "\\frac{\\mathrm{d}^2}{\\mathrm{d}[[0]]^2} $0", options: "rmA"},
    {trigger: /dd_\{3\}([A-Za-z])/, replacement: "\\frac{\\mathrm{d}^3}{\\mathrm{d}[[0]]^3} $0", options: "rmA"},
    {trigger: /d(?!d)([A-Za-z])d([A-Za-z])/, replacement: "\\frac{\\mathrm{d}[[0]]}{\\mathrm{d}[[1]]}$0", options: "rmA"},
    {trigger: /d_\{2\}([A-Za-z])d([A-Za-z])/, replacement: "\\frac{\\mathrm{d}^2[[0]]}{\\mathrm{d}[[1]]^2}$0", options: "rmA"},
    {trigger: /d_\{3\}([A-Za-z])d([A-Za-z])/, replacement: "\\frac{\\mathrm{d}^3[[0]]}{\\mathrm{d}[[1]]^3}$0", options: "rmA"},
	{trigger: "nthd", replacement: "\\frac{\\mathrm{d}^{${0:n}} ${1:f}}{\\mathrm{d}${2:x}^{$0}}$3", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "der", replacement: "\\frac{\\mathrm{d}${0:y}}{\\mathrm{d}${1:x}} $2", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "de2", replacement: "\\frac{\\mathrm{d}^2 ${0:y}}{\\mathrm{d}${1:x}^2} $2", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "de3", replacement: "\\frac{\\mathrm{d}^3 ${0:y}}{\\mathrm{d}${1:x}^3} $2", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "dt", replacement: "\\mathrm{d}t", options: "mAw"},
    {trigger: "dx", replacement: "\\mathrm{d}x", options: "mAw"},
    {trigger: "dy", replacement: "\\mathrm{d}y", options: "mAw"},
    {trigger: "dz", replacement: "\\mathrm{d}z", options: "mAw"},
    {trigger: "ds", replacement: "\\mathrm{d}s", options: "mAw"},
    {trigger: "du", replacement: "\\mathrm{d}u", options: "mAw"},

    {trigger: /([^\\])int/, replacement: "[[0]]\\int $0 \\, \\mathrm{d}${1:x} $2", options: "mA", priority: -1},
    {trigger: "int", replacement: "\\int $0 \\, \\mathrm{d}${1:x} $2", options: "mA", priority: -2},
    {trigger: "\\int", replacement: "\\int $0 \\, \\mathrm{d}${1:x} $2", options: "m"},
    {trigger: "dint", replacement: "\\int_{${0:0}}^{${1:1}} $2 \\, \\mathrm{d}${3:x} $4", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "oint", replacement: "\\oint_{$0} $1 \\, \\mathrm{d}${2:x} $3", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "iint", replacement: "\\iint $0 \\, \\mathrm{d}${1:x}\\,\\mathrm{d}${2:y} $3", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "tint", replacement: "\\iiint $0 \\, \\mathrm{d}${1:x}\\,\\mathrm{d}${2:y}\\,\\mathrm{d}${3:z} $4", options: "mA"},
    {trigger: "oinf", replacement: "\\int_{0}^{\\infty} $0 \\, \\mathrm{d}${1:x} $2", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "infi", replacement: "\\int_{-\\infty}^{\\infty} $0 \\, \\mathrm{d}${1:x} $2", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "eval", replacement: "\\Big|_{$0}^{$1} $2", options: "mA"},
	{trigger: "evb", replacement: "\\left[ $0 \\right]_{$1}^{$2} $3", options: "mA"},
